name: Barbell Bench Press
description: A standardized barbell compound/isolation movement targeting the chest. Maintain strict posture, brace abdominals, and adhere to clean tempo through the full range of motion.
animation_svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 200 140" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="wger-anim">
  <rect x="20" y="110" width="160" height="8" rx="3" fill="#334155"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="102" r="9" fill="#60a5fa"/>
  <rect x="65" y="98" width="75" height="12" rx="5" fill="#3b82f6"/>
  <path d="M 140 102 L 155 112 L 160 135" stroke="#93c5fd" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <g>
    <line x1="95" y1="102" x2="100" y2="60" stroke="#93c5fd" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="70" y1="56" x2="130" y2="56" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <rect x="66" y="46" width="6" height="20" rx="2" fill="#ef4444"/>
    <rect x="128" y="46" width="6" height="20" rx="2" fill="#ef4444"/>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0,0; 0,34; 0,0" dur="2.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </g>
</svg>
